verdict.rationale: Unreal's Remote Control system exposes a REST-like HTTP/WebSocket API (unreal-docs-22/23/24/25), so the axis of having an API is applicable, but there is no evidence anywhere in the pack of a downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger spec or other machine-readable API description for it. Probe evidence even shows Epic's docs are not fetchable as structured/markdown content and there's no official MCP or spec surface.
